class.name: TrackRenderingServer
class.brief_description: Draws the tracks and roads of [TrackServer], each by a render RID of its own.
class.description: Keeps a track's streaming, scenario, visibility and description (what the track is, a [TrackData]) and forwards its drawing to the backend its data names ([method TrackData.get_rendering_backend]; the project setting [code]reloaded/tracks/backend[/code] for none): the core's [StandardTrackRenderingBackend], or one a plugin registers ([method backend_register]). A streamed track is built while the camera is within [member tracks_distance] of it ([SceneryStreamingServer]).

method.name: backend_get
method.description: The backend registered under [param name], by its [ObjectID]; 0 for none.

method.name: backend_get_list
method.description: The names of the registered backends.

method.name: backend_register
method.description: The [TrackRenderingBackend] of [param backend_id] draws the tracks whose data names [param name]; it unregisters before it goes.

method.name: backend_unregister
method.description: Takes the backend away; the tracks it drew are drawn by no backend until their description names another.

method.name: track_create
method.description: [TrackServer]'s [param track] drawn under the render RID returned.

method.name: track_free
method.description: What the track drew goes, and its render RID.

method.name: track_free_many
method.description: The tracks [param track_renders] freed in one go.

method.name: track_get_render_rid
method.description: The render RID of [TrackServer]'s [param track]; an empty [RID] for a track not drawn.

method.name: track_rebuild
method.description: Builds the track again; a streamed one out of range is built when the camera comes back.

method.name: track_set_description
method.description: What the track is: the backend its data names draws it. Given before the track is streamed or built.

method.name: track_set_scenario
method.description: The world the track is drawn in.

method.name: track_set_visible
method.description: Shows or hides what the track draws.

method.name: track_stream
method.description: Registers the track for streaming instead of building it - a scenery has thousands of tracks. It is built when the camera comes within [member tracks_distance] of it and cleared when it leaves, unless its backend streams it itself.

members.member: How far the tracks are drawn [m] (the project setting [code]reloaded/scenery/tracks/distance[/code], read as the server is made); the traction over them is drawn as far.

constants.constant: How far the tracks are drawn by default [m].
